reason: In pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/cleanup_test.go the subtest seeds at :116 and runs `require`-based count assertions at :117-118 before `t.Cleanup` is registered at :120, so a FailNow in seeding or those assertions skips the DELETEs.
